cohortNote: PCA and K-means use the full 1004-participant eligible cohort and the same 360-column cortical-thickness recipe as every other exercise. Diagnosis, sex, site, and age are never inputs to PCA or K-means -- they are stored here only for display, joined onto cluster labels after clustering.

pca.note: Fit once (StandardScaler then PCA(n_components=50), random_state=0). PC1/PC2 scores are identical for every retained-PC count because PCA components are nested.
